instruction: Make the bullet text box on slide 2 align its text to the right.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the text alignment of the bullet text box on slide 2 (slide_idx=1, shape_idx=4) to right. The original file has this text box with center alignment. Evaluator checks that all 5 paragraphs in the text box have RIGHT alignment after modification.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts text alignment from the specified slide (slide_idx=1, slide 2) and shape (shape_idx=4, bullet text box)
Getter properly converts PP_ALIGN enum values to string representations ('LEFT', 'CENTER', 'RIGHT', 'JUSTIFY') and handles None as 'LEFT'
Metric correctly compares all paragraph alignments against expected 'RIGHT' alignment using all_paragraphs=true logic
Metric function properly accesses expected parameter directly (expected.get('alignment'), expected.get('all_paragraphs')) which is correct for type='rule'
Evaluator provides complete coverage: instruction requires changing alignment to right, evaluator verifies all paragraphs have right alignment
Postconfig appropriately activates window and saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Edge cases handled: missing file bytes, invalid slide/shape indices, shapes without text frames all return 0.0
Data flow is correct: getter extracts list of paragraph alignments -> metric checks all match 'RIGHT' -> returns 1.0 if all match, 0.0 otherwise
